'''Training patches''' were [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] awards presented for completing the [[training simulator]]'s obstacle course. There were at least seven training patches, each one modeled in the likeness of one of the Imperials' starfighters that was eligible for the simulator. They could be found under the training certificate of the [[Imperial Database|Imperial database]].
